name: Hebrews
title: Hebrews — Better in Every Way
tagline: Hold fast — we have a great High Priest.

author.traditional: Unknown (not Paul in the strict early tradition of many; Apollos/Barnabas theories exist).

date.range_display: Pre-70 likely (temple language present tense; no mention of destruction).
date.debate: Pre-70 likely (temple language present tense; no mention of destruction).

audience: Pressured Jewish Christians tempted to shrink back.
purpose: Show Christ’s supremacy; warn against apostasy; urge endurance.
christ: Final revelation; Apostle and High Priest; once-for-all sacrifice.
spirit: Speaks in Scripture; distributed gifts; grace.
jesus_in_this_book: Final revelation; Apostle and High Priest; once-for-all sacrifice.
how_to_read: Hear the warnings as real. Run to the throne of grace.
watchman_charge: Do not drift. Fix your eyes on Jesus. Draw near with a true heart.
mbt_note: Primary voice NKJV; parallels as engine shows.
